title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Wells Fargo and five others object to OKX-ICE tokenized stock listings: Report
summary: As of Friday, 22 companies had filed objections as part of the joint venture’s proposed tokenized stock platform under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

title: SpaceX Filing Gives Elon Musk the Final Word on Tesla Merger He Says He’s Staying Out Of
summary: SpaceX’s latest 10-Q filing quietly confirms any Tesla combination requires sign-off from its “controlling shareholder.”

title: SEC Flags AI 'Super Intelligence' and Tokenization as Systemic Market Risks

title: Initia halts blockchain after exploit reportedly drains over $2.6M
summary: The blockchain suspended its layer-1 network and rollups after security researchers identified unauthorized token minting and millions in assets transferred to Ethereum.

title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
summary: Daytona is building a cloud for agents that's like giving every agent its own computer. It has attracted founders of Stripe, Perplextity, Datadog, Mercor, and others as angels, it says.

title: SEC flags tokenization as high-risk area in 2027 market examinations
summary: The SEC’s latest priorities highlight tokenization as an emerging market risk, while cryptocurrencies remain absent as a standalone examination category.

title: What some of Anthropic’s backers are reportedly worth before its IPO
summary: Early-stage and follow-on investors in the AI lab are already sitting on major paper returns.

title: Cysic dangles a 10% bounty, hacker pours loot into Tornado Cash
summary: The attacker moved $744,000 in ETH and BNB to Tornado Cash after exploiting Cysic’s bridge to mint 10 million tokens on BNB Smart Chain.

title: HSBC launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin for retail payments
summary: HSBC is rolling out RedCoin wallets to PayMe users, with plans to support tokenized investment subscriptions and expand into institutional uses.

title: Malaysia, Thailand join Singapore’s cross-border stablecoin push
summary: BLOOM seeks to cut costs by helping financial institutions coordinate cross-border use of stablecoins and tokenized deposits.

title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
summary: Should OpenAI command an over $1 trillion valuation with this round, it would break records as the most highly valued private company ever.
